notes: seeded 1200 positions, 448 org rows, 742 tag rows
baseline feed answers from generation v1
no stage past the snapshot was ever reported; R1 falls back to the cutover reading
the candidate never tried to move routing
the log stood at 1260 when the cutover committed

R1.description: the snapshot materialises the whole boundary before the rebuild moves on
R1.reason: no observable snapshot stage and no cutover

R10.description: the append path keeps taking deliveries for the whole of a rebuild
R10.reason: deliveries were turned away while the rebuild was in flight

R11.description: a read in flight when the cutover lands is still answered out of a whole generation
R11.reason: no read was in flight across the cutover

R12.description: the org projection counts people as well as deliveries, and knows they are different

R13.description: the tag projection points at the newest delivery in its bucket, by event time

R14.description: the read path hands back everything the serving generation holds
R14.reason: routing never moved; there is no new generation being served

R15.description: losing the cache does not lose which generation is serving, or the rebuild
R15.reason: the cutover did not complete; there is no serving generation to lose the note of

R2.description: routing does not move while the new generation is behind the log

R3.description: a position is folded exactly once, first delivery authoritative

R4.description: counters bucket days by New York local date

R5.description: the three routing keys are never observed disagreeing

R6.description: the old generation is not retired while the new one is missing a position

R7.description: nothing on the read path depends on the old generation once it is gone
R7.reason: generation v1 was never retired; there is nothing to be independent of

R8.description: the read path serves the new generation, ordered and limited as specified
R8.reason: routing never moved; the read path is R2 and R6's business

R9.description: the new generation stays level with the log once it is the one serving
